nativeTab.method: Standalone Chromium with fresh dedicated profile and loopback CDP; project Playwright1.62.1 CLI attaches with noDefaults:true to existing default context. Passive document.visibilitychange/timer samples only while a uniquely identified own Windows window is minimized via ShowWindow. IsIconic confirms minimized at both OS endpoints; finally restores. No browser commands while minimized and no document.hidden override.

extremes.purpose: Odd dimensions exercise water refraction and both control extremes. All five controls are also driven to their HTML min/max bounds; frozen source time2. PNG byte observations are output evidence, not raw floating-point GPU readback.

loop.construction: 94 forward frames plus 94 reverse frames; reverse is media-only
loop.capture: Actual nonfallback TSL WebGPU canvas via captureStream(25) / MediaRecorder, source speed0.6

visualReview: Poster, source/default two-backend images, mobile controls, and max controls inspected; compressed poster and loop middle frame inspected separately before final approval handoff.
limits: Native document.hidden pause/resume verified on Windows Chromium151 by real window minimization; detailed scope and prior failed instrumentation in native-visibility.json.
Screenshot bytes are not raw floating-point GPU readback.
Mobile viewport is simulated; RAF intervals are not GPU render time.
